faqs.question: Does it handle UAE VAT and WPS automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. VAT return generation and WPS payroll files are created automatically from posted transactions.

faqs.question: Will legacy PL/SQL procedures be lost?
faqs.answer: No. Database packages are preserved on Oracle 19c; only the presentation layer and logic calls are refactored into services.

faqs.question: Is there any downtime during migration?
faqs.answer: None. Legacy and modern interfaces run in parallel on the same database until you choose full cutover.
